meaning: ST I q.10 a.1-2 with q.9 a.1: the altogether immutable (in potency in no respect) is eternal in Boethius' sense, with Eternal instantiated by the typed BoethianEternal over a duration frame. The two marks (no beginning or end, no succession) follow from the q.9 a.1 change principle alone; possession of life needs the separate open premise that pure act lives. The Comparator config also verifies three omission controls (changePrincipleNeeded, lifePremiseNeeded, successionOnlyPrincipleInsufficient) and a joint model with a pure-act being (premisesJointlySatisfiable).
